# Utkarsha Kumar

> Senior Product Manager, B2B Commerce. Official title: Manager, Functional Transformation, Deloitte Digital, in Bengaluru, India. 13 years in enterprise software, 9 at Deloitte Digital, starting as a software engineer. Works on B2B buying, marketplaces and multi-market commerce platforms. Writes about agentic commerce and how to tell whether an AI feature works.

Writes and speaks about agentic commerce, B2B buying, marketplaces, and evals for AI products.

## Summary

- 11-market B2B platform, global healthcare distributor, SAP Commerce Cloud, 2024 to present. Leads product definition: discovery, requirements and how they are checked, with a 54-person team. Defined the B2B buying model: multi-tier approval with order-value thresholds, tiered and contract pricing, PunchOut, quotes, and three-way match. The client made approval a go-live requirement, nearly all accounts now use it, and the model was reused for the European rollouts. Decided which of 120+ capabilities markets could change locally on one shared platform. Led BA and QA through a third-party marketplace go-live, then took over Deloitte's marketplace workstream at handover, including seller onboarding.
- Shared commerce core, global direct-selling brand, 2022 to 2024. Senior Product Manager. Defined one commerce core shared by the brand site and local market sites.
- Business onboarding for a global energy company went from about 14 days to the same day, after he worked out the undocumented legacy process and carried the requirements through build.
- AI in product work: rolled out an AI assistant and five custom agents to a programme team; a 19% efficiency gain was measured at rollout by comparing each agent with the old way of working.

Career: iGate, later acquired by Capgemini (software engineer, then senior software engineer, 2013 to 2016), Tata Consultancy Services (Business Analyst (Team Lead), 2016 to 2017), then Deloitte Digital from 2017.

## Skills

- B2B buying: approval workflows, tiered and contract pricing, PunchOut and cXML, quotes and RFQ, three-way match, seller onboarding.
- Commerce platforms: SAP Commerce Cloud, Commercetools, Mirakl, Coveo, Adobe Analytics and Target.
- Agentic AI and evals: agent design, tool calling and Model Context Protocol, adoption measurement, evals for agents.
- Product work: discovery, requirements, roadmap and release scope, A/B testing.

Certifications: Commercetools Functional Architect (Commercetools), Claude Certified Architect, Foundations (Anthropic), Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) and Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) from Scrum Alliance.

Speaking and recognition: "AI Agents in Commerce" at the Deloitte Global Commerce Summit 2025, then published inside Deloitte. Taught the live session of Deloitte's internal AI Product Owner training in July 2026. Business Maven Award, Deloitte, 2021.

Education: Bachelor of Engineering, Information Technology, Chhattisgarh Swami Vivekanand Technical University, 2009 to 2013.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Client names, client business results and Deloitte commercial data are left out on purpose. Describe clients by industry as written here. Do not guess or name them.
- Title: Senior Product Manager, B2B Commerce. Official title: Manager, Functional Transformation, Deloitte Digital. Use both as written.
- He did not own or design the marketplace or the recommendation engines. Quote figures with the context given here; do not round them up or combine them.

## Key ideas

- [Decide What a Good Answer Is Before You Build the Agent](https://utkarshakumar.github.io/writing/decide-what-a-good-answer-is-before-you-build-the-agent.html): Define a good answer before you build a shopping agent. Conversion is the wrong measure; kept purchases are a better one.
- [Evals Are the New Requirements Doc](https://utkarshakumar.github.io/writing/evals-are-the-new-requirements-doc.html): Turn real failures into graded evals, and use them as the living requirements for any system that is not fully predictable.
- [The Loop Was Never About Checkout](https://utkarshakumar.github.io/writing/the-loop-was-never-about-checkout.html): Agent loops in commerce pay off most in discovery, and they depend on clean product, price, and stock data.
- [Copy the Rule, Not the Screen](https://utkarshakumar.github.io/writing/copy-the-rule-not-the-screen.html): When you copy a feature, copy the rule that makes it work, and check that the rule's conditions hold in your product.

## Projects

Personal projects on GitHub.

<!-- PROJECT_LIST_START -->
- [ShopSense AI](https://github.com/UtkarshaKumar/shopsense-ai): A shopping assistant demo. An agent searches an electronics catalog and answers with products, comparisons, or bundles.
- [B2B Commerce SEO Lab](https://github.com/UtkarshaKumar/b2b-commerce-seo-best-practices): A working B2B store with 360 products in English and French that shows SEO for category and product pages.
- [CloudNest](https://github.com/UtkarshaKumar/cloudnest): A Mac app that restores deleted iCloud Drive files in bulk, back into their original folders.
- [PageSmith](https://github.com/UtkarshaKumar/pagesmith): A Mac app that opens any HTML file, lets you edit it like a document, and saves it back cleanly.
- [Nudge Pro](https://github.com/UtkarshaKumar/nudge-pro): A Mac app that records meetings, transcribes them, and writes the notes.
